passages.note: Bill details page lists Heaton as a co-author of HJR 3, a proposed constitutional marriage amendment.
passages.actor_quote: Co-Authored by: Rep. Timothy Wesco, Rep. Wes Culver, Rep. Rhonda Rhoads, Rep. Robert Heaton, Rep. Don Lehe, Rep. Matthew Lehman, Rep. Randall Frye.

passages.provision_quote: Section 38. Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana.
passages.note: The operative text of HJR 3 as co-authored, defining marriage exclusively as between one man and one woman.
House Roll Call 70, 3rd reading of HJR 3; Heaton is listed among the Yea votes.

rows.reasoning: Heaton co-authored and voted Yea (House Roll Call 70, 3rd reading) on HJR 3 (2014), whose sole operative section states 'Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana.' The text is silent on civil unions but bars recognition of same-sex marriage, matching the rung 'Make same-sex marriage illegal and define marriage as only between one man and one woman.'
